input: Search the web for "summer childcare" and school-age summer care for kids and teens in Haywood, Jackson and Swain counties, NC (Waynesville, Canton, Sylva, Cherokee). Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Haywood County Schools
candidates.note: School-based summer care at Bethel, Clyde, Meadowbrook and Jonathan Valley; Bethel's 2026 program ran June 10–August 6, weekdays 7:30–5.

candidates.name: Haywood Haven
candidates.note: Summer Community Center for kindergarten–sixth grade, Tuesdays and Thursdays June–August; summer program referenced in 2026 enrollment information.

candidates.name: First Baptist Church of Sylva
candidates.note: First Explorers summer care ran in 2025 and 2026, with chapel, swimming, parks, crafts and field trips.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of the Plateau
candidates.note: Summer care for rising grades 1–12, June 8–August 7, 2026; includes Cashiers Club and Abell Teen Club, excluding its Highlands location.

candidates.name: Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians — Cherokee Youth Center
candidates.note: Boys & Girls Clubs of Cherokee youth and teen programming; 2025 handbook includes the project-based Summer Brain Game program.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Haywood County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Fun programs offered hands-on learning for ages 5–18; not continuous summer childcare.

candidates.name: Haywood County Soil and Water Conservation District
candidates.note: YES summer day camp for rising eighth and ninth graders, with environmental learning and regional field trips.

candidates.name: Waynesville Hollers
candidates.note: Organization's website lists a 2026 summer camp; a sports program rather than continuous summer childcare.
